{{Quote|And the bounty on you, Somaz, is worth a fortune.|Boba Fett reveals his knowledge of the price on Somaz's head|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
'''Somaz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] treasurer hunter active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He devoted most of his adult life to searching for the artifact known as the [[Arachedron sculpture]], which he eventually found on board the derelict luxury cruiser ''[[Reverie]]''. Whilst he attempted to retrieve the sculpture he was interrupted by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and the [[Rolu Strom|Strom brothers]]. Despite the hunters presence, Somaz retrieved the sculpture which triggered a large number of [[Arachedron]] to attack all four men present. Fett took the sculpture, which the [[Insect/Legends|insects]] were attracted to, and hurled it away into the depths of the ship and used the distraction to escape. Somaz begged Fett to save him and offered payment, which Fett accepted. The bounty hunter later revealed he had saved the treasure hunter as there was a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've been on this ship for two weeks searching for this thing&mdash;you can't just come along and snatch it from me!|Somaz refuses to hand over the sculpture to the bounty hunters|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
Somaz was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] who worked as a treasure hunter, devoting most of his adult life to finding the artifact known as the [[Arachedron sculpture]] and at some point in the process getting a large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on his head. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Somaz spent [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] searching for the sculpture aboard the luxury cruiser ''[[Reverie]]'' which lay wrecked in a [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] at the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He was eventually successful in finding the sculpture, which made up the head of a multi-armed statue located deep within the ship. To retrieve the Arachedron sculpture, Somaz killed one of the many [[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like [[Arachedron]] creatures that lived on the ship and seemed to be attracted to the sculpture. Wearing the creatures corpse to disguise himself the treasure hunter made his way to the statue and scaled it, but as he reached the top the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and the two bounty hunting Strom brothers, [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom|Rolu]] approached the statue.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

The three hunters explained that they were there to claim the valuable artifact for themselves, and demanded Somaz hand it over. The Dresssellian cursed his luck and removed the sculpture, causing a huge number of Arachedron to become frenzied and attack all four hunters. As the group fought of the [[Insect/Legends|insects]] Somaz explained that it was the artifact that the creatures wanted, not them. Coming to the decision that the value of the artifact wasn't worth his life, Fett took the sculpture from Somaz and hurled it into the depths of the ship, causing the Arachedron to follow. Horrified at Fett's decision Rolu leapt at the Mandalorian and cursed him before leaping after it into the abyss. Edo reached to try and save his brother but failed, prompting Somaz to try and pull back Edo and persuade him it was time to leave. Edo refused to leave though and followed his brother into the depths of the collapsing ship, returning Fett's [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] first. As the ship came down around them Somaz begged Fett to help him get out alive and offered to pay him 50,000[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if he saved him. Fett asked for 100,000 credits, to which Somaz agreed and so the Mandalorian used his jetpack to carry Somaz to safety. As the pair left the graveyard in Fett's ship, [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], the treasure hunter transferred Fett the promised money. after which Fett revealed he had recognized Somaz and new there was a bounty on him, which the bounty hunter planned to claim.<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've spent a good part of my life chasing that Arachedron. I might of chased it into the abyss right along with them.|Somaz reflects on the fate of the Strom brothers|<ref name="BFatSoF" />}}
Somaz devoted most of his adult life to hunting the Arachedron sculpture, being dedicated enough to spend weeks alone searching for it in a dangerous and abandoned cruiser. He managed to work out a way to get pass the Arachedron guarding his target and was willing to wear a corpse on his back to do so. After retrieving the sculpture he was willing to sacrifice it, and almost every [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] he owned to save his own life. Once safe he admitted that the Strom's brothers suicidal pursuit of the sculpture had scared him but reflected that he might of done the same. Somaz had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and was without hair. Whilst on the ''Reverie'' he wore a brown [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] along with a brown [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] and pants. He also made use of a pair of red [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]].<ref name="BFatSoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Somaz first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], pencilled by [[Daxiong]] and released in [[2011]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars Adventures]]'' series.<ref name="BFatSoF" />
